name: VaultSparkStudios.github.io
currentFocus: S340 ran the arc under founder authorization for a direct push to main and a full production deploy. FIRST, it found the E2E Test Suite had been failing on every push for more than 17 hours -- eight consecutive runs -- with nothing surfacing it. Both jobs died on the same HTTP smoke pre-gate, which asserted /vaultsparked/ and /ranks/ as 200 pages carrying the body of stubs that S335 deleted; because it is a PRE-gate it also hid eight further stranded Playwright specs that never got to run. The root cause was an asymmetry S338 fixed around rather than fixed: local-preview-server.mjs deliberately parses _headers, and never parsed _redirects, so the preview answers every retired route 404 where the edge answers 301 -- the identical asymmetry that cost S338 twenty-seven hours of Lighthouse verdicts. The preview now applies _redirects with the edge precedence, which resolves every stranded consumer at once and covers every future route merge automatically, and the smoke asserts the 301 CONTRACT derived from config/route-consolidation.json rather than a typed list: 12 checks became 26 with zero failures, and all eight formerly-stranded specs pass. SECOND, the gate built in S338 for exactly this class had stayed green through all 17 hours because its subject was workflow YAML while the routes lived one hop in, inside a script the YAML runs by name; it now follows the invocation edge, with two refinements making it real -- a target expecting a 3xx asserts a merge contract rather than auditing a page, without which it would have refused this session own repair, and a skip:true entry asserts nothing, which it discovered against itself on its first live run. 29/29, reproduced in both directions against the real files. THIRD, the postbuild ordering question carried and deferred twice is answered by instrument rather than a third reading: a preload observes the real fs calls of all 22 steps, and with transforms excluded and no-op writes discounted the measured answer is that S338 fix holds. FOURTH, that run found a defect nobody was hunting -- propagate-nav strips the /evidence/ link from 125 pages every build and generate-evidence-hub restores it, net-zero in git and therefore invisible to every existing gate. Two deferrals were published with their reasons rather than half-built beside a deploy: the nav registration (five consumers) and the art-only cover regeneration (rotates the home LCP asset).
publicNote: Fixed a continuous-integration blackout: the automated browser test suite had been failing on every change for over 17 hours because the local preview server did not apply the same redirect rules as the live site. The preview is now faithful to production, and the checks that guard every public page are producing verdicts again.
nextMilestone: Register /evidence/ in config/intelligence-suite.json to end the 125-page nav tug-of-war, execute the art-only cover regeneration whose direction is already decided, and close the resync-derived coverage gap so a rebase cannot leave a gated artifact stale.
